verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is Unity's first-party claim that it builds both 2D and 3D games. That establishes 2D as a supported target, but nothing in the pack shows a dedicated 2D toolset or that 2D is first-class rather than secondary to its 3D-heavy positioning. Missing for 10: documentation of sprite tooling, tilemap editing and 2D physics; evidence that the 2D workflow is first-class rather than layered on 3D; independent or hands-on corroboration of 2D workflow quality.
